plain: Rule by a small upper class; the nobility

webster.text: A form of government, in which the whole supreme power is vested in the principal persons of a state; or in a few men distinguished by their rank and opulence.

example.quote: The same that ought to be given to those who tell us that a government, the whole power of which would be in the hands of the elective and periodical servants of the people, is an aristocracy, a monarchy, and a despotism.
